_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. preflight generates this programmatically with json.dump and
writes it beside a staged copy of the script in an isolated temp directory.
Never hand-maintain it: a malformed config makes pyright fall back to defaults
and exit NORMALLY, silently disabling the gate.
'include' must name the single staged file. With ['.'] pyright analysed 4 files
and produced 1168 diagnostics instead of 1 and 7, and the cost scales with the
'extraPaths' is discovered at runtime, never hardcoded: %APPDATA% can be
redirected, and the path differs on macOS.
'reportArgumentType: none' is required. Fusion enums are plain classes with int
attributes while parameters are annotated with the enum class type, so every
enum argument would otherwise raise a false positive and drown the signal.
